description.value: Rotary Pool is a seasonal outdoor public swimming pool in Chilliwack, owned by the City and operated by the YMCA of BC. It offers public swims, swimming lessons, and special events during the warmer months. For touring cyclists passing through Chilliwack in summer, the pool could provide a refreshing break from the road.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Rotary Pool is a City of Chilliwack-owned outdoor pool operated by the YMCA of BC, offering public swimming, lessons, and special events seasonally (May–September). The address (46245 Reece Avenue) and phone (604.795.5562) on the website match OSM. No information about bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any other cyclist-specific amenities is mentioned on the website, so all required criteria and optional amenities are null.
concerns: Seasonal facility (May–September only); not available to cyclists outside this window.
